name: Near-head-on, 10 degrees off reciprocal
description: Target approaches nearly dead ahead, but its heading is 10 deg off an exact reciprocal course -- Rule 14's 'reciprocal or nearly reciprocal' wording should still apply. Correct: Rule 14(c) -- when in doubt, assume head-on, and both vessels alter to starboard.
pass_criteria: Own-ship classifies this as head-on (Rule 14) and turns to starboard.
